changedVerses.sourceText: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to the LORD of Armies in Shiloh. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests to the LORD, were there.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 「この人」は1:1ですでに名を示されたエルカナを指すため、エルカナをcontextで結ぶ。息子たち・祭司エリ・シロおよび主は本文に明記される。

changedVerses.sourceText: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before the LORD.
changedVerses.reasonJa: ハンナの「わが主」は直前1:14で彼女を問いただした祭司エリへの呼びかけ。主（YHWH）への祈りの対象とは分け、エリをcontextで結ぶ。

changedVerses.sourceText: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by strength.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 「彼は…守る」の主語は直前2:8の主を引き継ぐ。神を主語のcontextとして追加し、歌の話者ハンナも詩歌の文脈として維持する。

changedVerses.sourceText: The custom of the priests with the people was that when anyone offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant came while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three teeth in his hand;
changedVerses.reasonJa: 2:13の祭司慣行の説明は場所を節内で再指示しない。章の場面がシロであることは背景文脈にとどめ、地名リンクを外す。

changedVerses.sourceText: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”
changedVerses.reasonJa: 2:15は祭司の従者と犠牲を捧げる人の会話で、場所を再指示しない。シロでの連続場面から地名をcontext追加するのは過剰なので外す。

changedVerses.sourceText: If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”
changedVerses.reasonJa: 2:16も祭司の従者との会話の続きで、地名を再指示しない。シロは章の背景場面にとどまるためリンクしない。

changedVerses.sourceText: The sin of the young men was very great before the LORD; for the men despised the LORD’s offering.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 「若者たち」の罪は2:12で紹介されたエリの二人の息子ホフニとピネハスを受ける。固有名再掲ではないため二人をcontextに結び、主は本文に明記される。

changedVerses.sourceText: No, my sons; for it is not a good report that I hear! You make the LORD’s people disobey.
changedVerses.reasonJa: この発話の話者はエリ。you/my sonsは続く2:25/34で名指すホフニとピネハスを受ける。神の民も明記される。

changedVerses.sourceText: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Did I reveal myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh’s house?

beforeExcluded.name: Pharaoh
beforeExcluded.reasonJa: 「Pharaoh’s house」は王家を指す表現で、本文は個人名や特定のファラオを同定しない。

changedVerses.reasonJa: 「Pharaoh’s house」は本文に明記される称号表現。既存のoffice-titleカードperson:pharaoh_2331をdirectで採用し、特定の王個人とは同定しない。エジプト、エリ、主も明記される。

changedVerses.sourceText: Didn’t I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? Didn’t I give to the house of your father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire?
changedVerses.reasonJa: 引用内のmy/Iは2:27から続く主の発話。神を話者contextとして加える。主語のhimは宛先エリで、既存contextを維持。イスラエルの部族は明記される。

changedVerses.sourceText: Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded in my habitation, and honor your sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel my people?’
changedVerses.reasonJa: 2:27から続く主の引用発話で、my/Iを話者の神へcontextで結ぶ。youはエリ、your sonsはホフニとピネハスを受ける。イスラエルも本文に明記。

changedVerses.sourceText: Behold, the days come that I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father’s house, that there will not be an old man in your house.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 「I will cut off」は主の発話が続くため神をcontextで追加する。your/your father’s houseはエリへの呼びかけで既存contextを維持。

changedVerses.sourceText: The man of yours whom I don’t cut off from my altar will consume your eyes and grieve your heart. All the increase of your house will die in the flower of their age.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 「I don’t cut off」「my altar」は主の発話を引き継ぐ。神を話者contextで追加し、「you/your house」はエリを受ける。

changedVerses.sourceText: This will be the sign to you that will come on your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they will both die.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 「I will give this sign」は主の続く発話。神をcontextで追加し、名指されたホフニとピネハスはdirectを維持。

changedVerses.sourceText: I will raise up a faithful priest for myself who will do according to that which is in my heart and in my mind. I will build him a sure house. He will walk before my anointed forever.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 「I will raise up」は主の発話なので神をcontextで結ぶ。ここでは将来の忠実な祭司は匿名であり、エリ本人と同定しないためエリcontextを除く。

changedVerses.sourceText: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 「I will perform」は3:11から続く主の発話。神を話者contextとして追加し、名指されたエリはdirectを維持。

changedVerses.sourceText: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knew, because his sons brought a curse on themselves, and he didn’t restrain them.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 「I have told / I will judge」は主の発話が継続。神を話者contextで追加し、himはエリ、his sonsは直前までに特定されたホフニとピネハス。

changedVerses.sourceText: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be removed with sacrifice or offering forever.”
changedVerses.reasonJa: 誓いを述べるIは3:11以来の主。神を話者contextで追加し、エリは本文に明記。

changedVerses.sourceText: He said, “What is the thing that he has spoken to you? Please don’t hide it from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all the things that he spoke to you.”
changedVerses.reasonJa: 「He said」の話者は直前3:16でサムエルを呼んだエリ。エリをcontextで追加し、himが語った先行発話の主は本文のGod do soにも明記される神。

changedVerses.sourceText: Samuel told him every bit, and hid nothing from him. He said, “It is the LORD. Let him do what seems good to him.”
changedVerses.reasonJa: 「Samuel told him」のhimは直前3:17で質問したエリ。エリをcontextで追加。サムエルは話者、主は引用中に明記される。

changedVerses.sourceText: The Philistines put themselves in array against Israel. When they joined battle, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men of the army in the field.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 本文は「Israel」を戦闘相手・敗者として明記するので、集団カードをcontextからdirectへ変更。

changedVerses.sourceText: When the ark of the LORD’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth resounded.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 「all Israel」が叫んだと明記されるため、集団カードはdirect。契約の箱の移動が主語ではない。

changedVerses.sourceText: The Philistines were afraid, for they said, “God has come into the camp.” They said, “Woe to us! For there has not been such a thing before.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 4:7の発話はPhilistineが敵陣を「the camp」と呼ぶだけでIsrael集団名を再言及しない。直前の陣営を背景として知れることだけでは集団リンクしない。神は敵側の引用に明記。

changedVerses.sourceText: Woe to us! Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods that struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 4:8は敵側の引用中で「Egyptians」や複数形mighty godsを述べるが、Israelの集団名はこの節にない。民族の背景や敵の複数形表現からIDを追加しない。

changedVerses.sourceText: The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for thirty thousand footmen of Israel fell.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 本文はIsraelが敗れ、Israelの歩兵が倒れたと明記するため、集団カードをdirectにする。

changedVerses.sourceText: When he made mention of God’s ark, Eli fell from off his seat backward by the side of the gate; and his neck broke, and he died, for he was an old man and heavy. He had judged Israel forty years.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 本文はEliを名指し、その転落・死を述べる。4:16からの照応に限らずこの節で直接名があるためdirect。Israelも本文に明記。

changedVerses.sourceText: His daughter-in-law, Phinehas’ wife, was with child, near to giving birth. When she heard the news that God’s ark was taken and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and gave birth; for her pains came on her.
changedVerses.reasonJa: 「Phinehas’ wife」はピネハスを明記するためdirect。「her father-in-law」は前後文脈のエリを指すのでcontext。神の箱は明記。匿名の女性本人を既存の別IDへ推測接続しない。

changedVerses.sourceText: About the time of her death the women who stood by her said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for you have given birth to a son.” But she didn’t answer, neither did she regard it.

afterExcluded.name: Ichabod
afterExcluded.reasonJa: この節は「息子」を生んだと述べるだけで、子の名は4:21で初めて明かされるため、この節ではリンクしない。

changedVerses.reasonJa: 女性と匿名の新生児だけが動作主体・対象で、Phinehasはこの節に出てこない。子の名Ichabodも4:21で初出のため4:20へ先取りして結び付けない。

changedVerses.sourceText: She named the child Ichabod, saying, “The glory has departed from Israel!” because God’s ark was taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.
changedVerses.reasonJa: Ichabodはこの節で初めて名指されるのでdirect。father-in-lawはEli、husbandはPhinehasを指すため二人はcontext。Israelと神の箱の主は節に明記。

changedVerses.sourceText: It was so, that after they had carried it there, the LORD’s hand was against the city with a very great confusion; and he struck the men of the city, both small and great, so that tumors broke out on them.
changedVerses.reasonJa: thereは5:8で運ばれたガトを指すため場所をcontextで追加。都市名の再明記ではない。主の手と腫れ物は本文に明記。

changedVerses.sourceText: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, “Send the ark of the God of Israel away, and let it go again to its own place, that it not kill us and our people.” For there was a deadly panic throughout all the city. The hand of God was very heavy there.
changedVerses.reasonJa: thereは5:10で運ばれたエクロンを指すため場所をcontextで追加。本文は集まった領主たちと神の箱の帰還も明記する。

deltaChanges.reasonJa: この節の引用はSamuelの前節からの演説の続きで、「あなたがた」はイスラエルの聞き手を指す。Samuelを話者contextとして加える。

deltaChanges.sourceText: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No, but we will have a king over us,
deltaChanges.reasonJa: 「民」は王を求めてSamuelに応じるイスラエルの聞き手集団を指す。Samuelは直名で記される。

deltaChanges.sourceText: “Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man out of the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel. He will save my people out of the hand of the Philistines; for I have looked upon my people, because their cry has come to me.”

afterExcluded.reasonJa: ここでは「land of Benjamin」という領域を指すため、ベニヤミン族の集団IDではなく既存の地域IDを採用。

afterExcluded.reasonJa: この発話では「a man」とだけ述べ、予告された人物をこの節の匿名表現からSaulへ名指しリンクしない。

deltaChanges.reasonJa: 神がSamuelに語り続け、「あなた」は預言を聞くSamuelを指す。イスラエルとベニヤミンの地は本文に明記。

deltaChanges.sourceText: When all who knew him before saw that, behold, he prophesied with the prophets, then the people said to one another, “What is this that has come to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”
deltaChanges.reasonJa: 本文は「Kishの子」と明記するため、Saulに加えて父Kishをdirectで結ぶ。

deltaChanges.sourceText: Saul’s uncle said to him and to his servant, “Where did you go?” He said, “To seek the donkeys. When we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.”

deltaChanges.sourceText: But you have today rejected your God, who himself saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and you have said to him, ‘No! Set a king over us!’ Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and by your thousands.”
deltaChanges.reasonJa: 「あなたがたは神を退けた」というSamuelの発話が続く。神とIsraelは本文に明記され、Samuelは話者context。

deltaChanges.sourceText: When the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, “What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?” They understood that the LORD’s ark had come into the camp.
deltaChanges.reasonJa: 「ヘブライ人の陣営」は本文中の直接的な集団呼称で、既存のIsrael集団IDに対応する。場所や個人ではない。

deltaChanges.sourceText: Be strong and behave like men, O you Philistines, that you not be servants to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Strengthen yourselves like men, and fight!”
deltaChanges.reasonJa: Philistineの発話は「ヘブライ人」を直接名指す。既存Israel IDは集団を表すためdirect aliasとして扱う。

deltaChanges.sourceText: (In earlier times in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he said, “Come! Let’s go to the seer;” for he who is now called a prophet was before called a seer.)
